cyclingMeasureAssessment.conclusion: For wallets whose episodes are still open (T9, P7, M8) swaps-per-token near 1 plus living holdings supports 'collects without re-trading'. For vanished-position wallets (M4, M5, M6, L5) the stored data CANNOT distinguish 'collects without re-trading' from 'rarely reaches zero inventory' — exactly the §2 ambiguity — so they are classified AMBIGUOUS rather than validated.

formulaDecision.correction: replace CYCLE_SCARCITY = 100/(1 + completedPositions + reentries) with CYCLING_SCARCITY = 100/(1 + disposalLegs + reentryLegs), where disposalLegs = PARTIAL_SELL + EXIT legs
formulaDecision.semanticJustification: the archetype sentence is 'continues adding new assets rather than repeatedly TRADING the same asset'; a BUY -> PARTIAL_SELL -> ADD -> PARTIAL_SELL loop is repeat trading even though it never reaches a full EXIT. Counting only completed positions measures 'rarely reaches zero inventory', not 'rarely re-trades'. ADDs remain acceptable (accumulating more of a held asset is collector-consistent).
formulaDecision.notWalletTargeted: the correction is derived from the archetype definition and the phase's own BUY/PARTIAL_SELL/ADD example; it is NOT chosen to exclude or keep any specific wallet (bounded offline effect: P4 97->77, P7 73.6->71, M8 73.2->70.6 still assign; heavier partial cyclers would fall at implementation time when leg counts exist)
